title: backlog.py set --add no longer appends to every list field in the call
goal: A backlog.py set call that names --add with a list field (--check, --touch, --link, --depends, --relates) beside --notes or another field never silently appends to a list the caller meant to replace: either --add applies per field or set refuses the mix, naming the fields, as the gate add-scope settles; every skill and agent that documents --add says the same. Found in SP-eahtellz: set ST-4mcoplex --check ... --notes ... --add appended a check instead of replacing it.

run: import subprocess as s,sys,tempfile,os,json,shutil;d=os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(),'wt');s.run(['git','worktree','add','-q','--detach',d],check=True);f=os.path.join(d,'kb','_self','backlog','ST-akicahgy.json');n=len(json.loads(open(f,encoding='utf-8-sig').read())['checks']);r=s.run([sys.executable,os.path.join(d,'_tools','backlog.py'),'set','ST-akicahgy','--check','python3 _tools/check.py','--notes','x','--add'],cwd=d,capture_output=True,text=True);m=len(json.loads(open(f,encoding='utf-8-sig').read())['checks']);shutil.rmtree(d,ignore_errors=True);s.run(['git','worktree','prune']);print('set exit',r.returncode,'checks before',n,'after',m);sys.exit(0 if m<=n else 1)

gates.question: How should backlog.py set treat --add when a call names a list field beside --notes or another field?
options: refuse: set refuses a call that mixes --add with more than one field, naming them, so each append is its own call
per-field: separate append flags (--add-check, --add-touch, --add-notes, ...) replace the shared --add
gates.recommendation: refuse: set refuses a call that mixes --add with more than one field, naming them, so each append is its own call
gates.answer: per-field: separate append flags (--add-check, --add-touch, --add-notes, ...) replace the shared --add

notes: Premise (run 2026-10-07 on origin/main): the check prints 'set exit 0 checks before 1 after 2' and exits 1. bl_items.py, .claude/skills/ and .claude/agents/ are rule-guarding, so gate add-scope is blocking and asked before any code.
